title: 52-Hertz Whales (bcSunday)
synopsis: Scientists believe that there is a single whale in the ocean whose calls reverberate at 52-hertz, a frequency that cannot be heard by any other whale. Based on Machida Sonoko’s award-winning novel, Narushima Izuru’s empathetic drama shines a light on all the ‘52-hertz whales’ in the world, who tragically believe they live the loneliest of existences. After a life of abuse, Kiko moves to a quiet seaside town. There, she meets a young boy who, like her, has also suffered domestic abuse. Through their shared pain, they also find much-needed solace.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 瀨戶內海的小鎮，曾遭受虐待的女子，隱居似地生活，與一名伶仃 孩子相遇後，逐漸喚起兩段憾事：竭力拯救她的補習老師與成為她 初戀的男上司。悲傷滙聚成河，我們流進彼此，形成海，卻無法完 全融合。曾執導《第八日的蟬》和《銀河鐵道之父》的成島出，改 編本屋大賞得獎小說，鯨魚是少數會自殺的情緒動物，而「52 赫 茲鯨魚」的高頻率歌聲在世界上無法被其他鯨魚接收，即使是最孤 獨的存在，也有一直游下去的力量。

cast: Hana Sugisaki, Jun Shison, Hio Miyazawa
